description: This file contains unit tests for the 'calculate' function in a calculator application, using the Chai assertion library and Mocha testing framework. It defines helper functions to simulate button presses and verify calculator behavior, and includes multiple test cases covering various calculator operations and edge cases.

methods.name: pressButtons
methods.description: Simulates pressing a sequence of calculator buttons and returns the resulting calculator state.

methods.name: expectButtons
methods.description: Asserts that pressing a sequence of buttons results in an expected calculator state.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for calculator button sequences and expected outcomes.
